mapper.select: /* selectAtendComplPreconMngList (출석 및 이수현황 상세 조회) - Lee Hye Sun */ SELECT B.SEMSTR_SE_CD , B.RPT_MM , B.CLASS_DAYCNT , B.ATEND_DAYCNT , B.ABSNC_DAYCNT , B.LATEN_DAYCNT , B.LRLY_DAYCNT , CASE WHEN CLASS_DAYCNT != 0 THEN ROUND((NVL(ATEND_DAYCNT,0)+((NVL(LATEN_DAYCNT,0)+NVL(LRLY_DAYCNT,0))/3))/NVL(CLASS_DAYCNT,0)*100, 2) || '%' ELSE '-' END AS ATEND_RATE , PRTCLR_MATTER_DTL_CN , DEC_B64(D.FLNM_ENCPT) AS FLNM_ENCPT , DEC_B64(D.MBL_TELNO_ENCPT) AS MBL_TELNO_ENCPT FROM SEB510 A LEFT JOIN AFA700 B ON A.CASE_MNG_NO = B.CASE_MNG_NO AND A.CASE_MNG_ODRNO = B.CASE_MNG_ODRNO AND A.RESRCE_NO = B.RESRCE_NO LEFT JOIN AFA320 C ON A.CASE_MNG_NO = C.CASE_MNG_NO AND A.CASE_MNG_ODRNO = C.CASE_MNG_ODRNO AND A.RESRCE_NO = C.RESRCE_NO LEFT JOIN SCA100 D ON B.PIC_NO = D.ENFSN_NO JOIN SEB100 E ON A.CASE_MNG_NO = E.CASE_MNG_NO AND A.CASE_MNG_ODRNO = E.CASE_MNG_ODRNO LEFT JOIN SEA200 F ON E.TRPR_INFO_NO = F.TRPR_INFO_NO WHERE B.CASE_MNG_NO = #{CASE_MNG_NO} AND B.CASE_MNG_ODRNO = #{CASE_MNG_ODRNO} AND B.RESRCE_NO = #{RESRCE_NO}
